Three people associated with one legal seat within about 16 months; not fully reconciled by any single fetched source.

A Blue Energy press release specifically titled 'Blue Energy Achieves Key U.S. NRC Licensing Milestone, Paving the Way for Power in 48 Months or Less' (containing a strong regulatory-topic Jurewicz quote per two independent WebSearch summaries) returned HTTP 404 on every direct WebFetch attempt against blueenergy.co, and no working mirror was found -- the quote was dropped rather than shipped as snippet-only with an uncertain date.

Blue Energy's Matt Slotkin is described as 'Chief Operating Officer' in some secondary press coverage, but the company's own About page (fetched) lists him only as 'Co-founder' with no operating title -- recorded as the more conservative, company-sourced title.

leaders.name: Steven Hellman
leaders.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
leaders.background: 35-year career spanning investment banking, business and law, including 25+ years as an investment banker at Credit Suisse and UBS, most recently Managing Director and Co-Head of UBS's Energy Transition investment banking group, where he advised TerraPower on financing strategy from 2021-2025. Earlier in his career he was a business/finance attorney at Latham & Watkins and EVP at UniSite, Inc. Holds a B.A. in Soviet Studies from UC Berkeley and a J.D. from UC Berkeley School of Law.
leaders.why_they_matter: Succeeded longtime CFO Marcia Burkey at the moment TerraPower needs to close Natrium project financing and structure commercial partnerships beyond its DOE-backed demonstration plant.

sources.label: TerraPower — "TerraPower Announces Expansion of Executive Leadership Team"

leaders.name: Eric Williams
leaders.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer
leaders.background: 22-year engineering career including 15 years developing nuclear power plant designs; spent four years at B&W mPower developing a small modular reactor and led Integrated Systems Test facility development; earlier career work included severe accident analysis and current-fleet modernization. Promoted to COO from Senior Vice President and Design Authority for Natrium technology. Holds a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the University of Florida, an MBA from Lynchburg College, and is a licensed Professional Engineer.
leaders.why_they_matter: TerraPower's first COO, promoted from the engineer who was Natrium's own design authority rather than hired from outside — signals the company putting a technical insider in charge of execution as Natrium moves from construction into commissioning.

sources.label: TerraPower — "TerraPower Announces Expansion of Executive Leadership Team"
sources.quote: Eric's deep experience, proven leadership, and commitment to TerraPower's mission uniquely position him for this role

leaders.name: Jesse B. Walker
leaders.title: Vice President, Chief Supply Chain Officer
leaders.background: 21-year career at Northrop Grumman, including Vice President of Global Supply Chain and Corporate Director of Supplier Management, with senior supply chain and operations leadership roles in the Tactical Space Systems and Navigation and Targeting divisions. U.S. Air Force veteran (active duty and civil service). Holds an MBA with Honors from Webster University and a B.A. in Economics from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
leaders.why_they_matter: X-energy's first named chief supply chain officer, hired as the company signs multi-year long-lead-component agreements (e.g. the Jan 2026 SGL Carbon graphite deal) to move Xe-100/TRISO-X from pilot to fleet-scale sourcing.

sources.label: X-energy — "X-energy Adds Jesse B. Walker to Leadership Team as Chief Supply Chain Officer"
sources.quote: Jesse's exceptional background in global supply chain strategy and program management will be a critical asset

leaders.name: Mike Starrett
leaders.title: Chief Commercial Officer
leaders.background: Joined Radiant in May 2025 as the company's first Chief Revenue Officer, leading its federal business development team; by an August 2026 trade-press mention he was being referred to as Chief Commercial Officer -- title recorded here as reported in each fetched source, since no single source documents a formal title change. Holds a Ph.D. Prior role (per company announcement, not independently fetched) was Chief Commercial Officer for Ocean Winds North America, an offshore wind developer.
leaders.why_they_matter: Radiant's top commercial executive as the company executes its roughly $750M Army Janus microreactor contract and works to convert military-first deployments into commercial (data center, industrial) customers.

leaders.title: President, Advanced Fuel Transportation Inc. (AFT, a NANO Nuclear subsidiary)
leaders.background: Former President of Global Transportation at UPS, where he also held Vice President of Package Operations and Southern California District Manager roles, sat on UPS's corporate safety council, and served on its Executive Business Planning Unit overseeing a $16 billion capital budget.
leaders.why_they_matter: Runs NANO Nuclear's dedicated HALEU-transportation subsidiary, which holds the exclusive license to a DOE-funded, national-lab-developed high-capacity HALEU transport basket -- a supply-chain chokepoint (getting enriched fuel from fabricator to reactor site) that most microreactor vendors do not control in-house.

leaders.name: Jordan Robison, P.E.
leaders.title: Chief Executive Officer

leaders.name: Douglass Robison
leaders.title: Founder, Executive Chairman and Chairman of the Board

leaders.why_they_matter: As executive chairman he remains the company's public voice on strategy even after stepping back from day-to-day CEO duties, and personally announced four executive hires (legal, nuclear, finance) in a single stretch (Oct 2025-Feb 2026) that built out Natura's C-suite ahead of the CEO transition.

quotes.speaker: Mike Starrett
quotes.role: Chief Revenue Officer (at the time), Radiant Industries
quotes.quote: As the energy demands of digital infrastructure continue to rise, our customers are looking for power that is not only reliable, but also rapidly
quotes.what_it_means: Confirms a named data-center operator (Equinix) placed a preorder with deposits for 20 Kaleidos microreactors (1 MW each, 5-year no-refuel cycle) -- a concrete commercial commitment from a hyperscale-adjacent customer, not just an LOI, and the clearest 'digital infrastructure' customer signal found for Radiant in this pass.

sources.label: Newswire.com — "Radiant Announces Equinix Preorder & Deposits for 20 Kaleidos Microreactors" (Aug 14, 2025)
sources.quote: This agreement with Equinix demonstrates the critical need to deliver dependable power anywhere it's needed, within days

quotes.speaker: Dr. Kris Singh
quotes.role: President and Chief Executive Officer, Holtec International
quotes.quote: Hyundai E&C has the most distinguished credentials as a constructor of nuclear power plants
quotes.what_it_means: Holtec's CEO names its South Korean construction partner directly as the reason he believes Holtec's 'Mission 2030' fleet target (10 GW of SMR-300s) is achievable -- an explicit statement that Holtec is importing international (Korean) heavy-construction capability rather than relying on a purely domestic supply chain.

quotes.speaker: Jake Jurewicz
quotes.role: Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder, Blue Energy
quotes.venue: Company newsroom (press release with GE Vernova Hitachi)
quotes.quote: We are shifting from the old way of building large reactor nuclear power to instead do it the 'Blue Way' that slashes costs and time to power and finally makes nuclear a financeable, repeatable product.
quotes.what_it_means: Blue Energy's CEO states the company's entire value proposition as a direct contrast to conventional large-reactor construction economics -- cost and schedule reduction through shipyard prefabrication -- though he stops short of naming a $/kW or $/MWh figure.
